sn3.7:1.3: aḍḍakaraṇe → atthakaraṇe (pts) | kāmanidānaṁ kāmādhikaraṇaṁ → kāmanidānam kāmādhikakaraṇaṁ (pts) | aḍḍakaraṇe → atthakaraṇe (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ. pī.) | atthakaraṇe → a. evaṁ. ba. aṭṭakaraṇe (sya-all: sī. yu.) | atthakaraṇe → So SS. and C.; B. aṭṭakaraṇe. (pts note)
sn3.7:1.5: aḍḍakaraṇena bhadramukho dāni aḍḍakaraṇena → atthakaraṇena bhadramukhodāni atthakaraṇe na (bj, sya-all) | aḍḍakaraṇena → atthakaraṇena (pts) | bhadramukho → So B.and C.; S1 bhadrathamukho; S1 bhadātha-. (pts note)
sn3.7:2.1: mahārāja → ( ) sī. pī. potthakesu natthi (cck note)
sn3.7:2.2: ye → idha “evametaṁ mahārāja, evametaṁ mahārāja” itipāṭho marammasyāma potthakesu dissate (bj note) | mahārāja → B. Evam etaṁ mahārāja evam etaṁ mahārāja ye pi te mahārāja-. (pts note)
sn3.7:3.4: khipaṁva → khippaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā, PTS, sī.pævi, sī.pavi)
sn3.7:3.6: pāpakoti → pāpako ti sāvatthi (pts) | ti → Cf. the gāthā of the preceding Sutta. (pts note)
